subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Principle of Least Privilege
description: A quick, practical guide to Principle of Least Privilege.

hook.text: An intern's account has admin access 'just in case.' Their credentials get phished. Entire database exposed.

buildup.text: Every user, service, and process should have only the minimum permissions needed for their job.

discovery.text: Least privilege limits blast radius. A compromised account can only damage what it has access to.

twist.text: Convenience fights least privilege. 'Give everyone admin' is easier but catastrophically risky.

climax.text: After restricting the intern's account, a phishing attack compromises nothing. No admin, no damage.

punchline.text: Grant the minimum needed. Nothing more. Ever.

quiz.question: What does least privilege limit?
options: The damage a compromised account can cause
